projects.name: Austin, Texas data center (CoreWeave 16 MW)
projects.quote: On February 29, 2024, the Company entered into a long-term contract with CoreWeave, Inc. (“CoreWeave”) to deliver 16 MW of infrastructure at the Company’s Austin, Texas facility.

projects.name: CoreWeave 200 MW HPC hosting contracts
projects.quote: Following the commencement of operations in the Austin, Texas facility, on June 3, 2024, the Company entered into a series of long-term contracts with CoreWeave to deliver approximately 200 MW of infrastructure to host CoreWeave’s HPC operations, which will require the Company to modify multiple existing sites.

projects.name: CoreWeave 70 MW option
projects.quote: On June 25, 2024, the Company announced CoreWeave’s execution of an option to secure an additional 70 MW of infrastructure to host its HPC operations.

projects.name: CoreWeave 112 MW option
projects.quote: In June and August 2024, the Company announced CoreWeave’s execution of options to secure an additional 70 MW and 112 MW, respectively, of infrastructure to host its HPC operations.

projects.name: CoreWeave 120 MW final option
projects.quote: On October 22, 2024, the Company announced that CoreWeave had exercised its final option for an additional 120 MW of infrastructure.
